LightningComponentBundle.description: Shows search results for the term in the page URL (?term=), grouped by object with optional object tabs, using an admin-defined search configuration.

property.name: configName
property.label: Search configuration
property.description: Which active Search Config controls the objects, fields, filters and boosts.

property.name: showFacets
property.label: Show filters
property.description: Shows a filter panel with the facets defined in the search configuration.

property.name: collapseFilters
property.label: Collapse each filter
property.description: Starts every filter in the panel collapsed, so visitors see a short list of filter names and open the ones they need. A filter with a selected value starts open.

property.name: showObjectTabs
property.label: Show object tabs
property.description: Shows an All tab plus one tab per searched object, so visitors can search a single object.
